label: vspreview current vpy
command: $python = if ($env:VPY_PYTHON) { $env:VPY_PYTHON } else { "python" }; $pidFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP "zed-vapoursynth-vspreview.json"; if (Test-Path $pidFile) { try { $old = Get-Content $pidFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $oldProcess = Get-Process -Id $old.id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($oldProcess -and $oldProcess.StartTime.Ticks -eq $old.startTime) { Stop-Process -Id $old.id -Force } } catch {} }; try { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match '(^|\s)-m\s+vspreview(\s|$)' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force } } catch {}; $process = Start-Process -FilePath $python -ArgumentList @("-m", "vspreview", ('"{0}"' -f "$ZED_FILE")) -NoNewWindow -PassThru; @{ id = $process.Id; startTime = $process.StartTime.Ticks } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content $pidFile; $process.WaitForExit(); exit $process.ExitCode
